pages.text: Printer I/O is simple by design:$(br)$(li)$(l)Top$() — input (templates, discs)$(li)$(l)Bottom$() — output (prints, ejected discs)$(li)$(l)Sides$() — filament spools ONLY$(br2)Hoppers work from Tier 1, and any pipe mod that respects inventory faces works too.

pages.title: Power & Filament
pages.text: RF cables connect on $(l)any$() face. Spools dock on the sides — Shift+Right Click the printer with a spool in hand, or Shift+Click it in the printer GUI.$(br2)Docked spools render on the machine and visibly shrink as filament depletes. The $(item)Filament Converter$() can keep them topped up automatically.

pages.title: Starting a Print
pages.text: Loading a disc arms the printer ($(l)Ready$()). Press $(l)Start$() in the GUI or pulse $(l)redstone$() to begin — or flip $(l)Auto$() on to start the moment a disc lands.$(br2)Use the X/Y/Z offsets in the GUI to move the build area; the default is centered directly above the printer.
